env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

logos lint ./...

! stdout .

-- go.mod --
module example.com/lintschema

go 1.27

-- logos.toml --
[lints]
correctness = "forbid"

slop = "deny"
complexity = "deny"
perf = "warn"
style = "warn"
suspicious = "warn"
portability = "warn"
pedantic = "allow"

[lints.thresholds]
max_nesting_depth = 3
max_cognitive_complexity = 15

max_function_params = 4
max_comptime_ast_nodes = 4096
max_ctfe_steps = 100000
